title: Final review of hn6 (watch becomes a dashboard)
description: Review hn6's full epic diff against its description, rules 1-8 and acceptance A1-A6. A6: J (u4l) proves the layout properties in the gate; the Bombadil-in-CI half is z7w's (outside this epic) — record whether z7w has landed and say so in the verdict rather than holding on it. Fold findings by seam.
